title: 第23章 异变第24章 莲子碎哪吒现
content_zh:
听云峰。
山君洞府内。
虎君皱眉看向白骨道君：
“道兄，我观那猴妖实力虽不错。”
“但也不至于几个回合便将你击败吧？”
对于白骨道君的实力。
虎君十分清楚。
对方真正战斗起来，实力绝不输于自己！
那猴妖虽天赋异禀。
但也不可能轻易击败地仙后期的白骨道君。
此时的白骨道君，气定神闲。
看不出半点被孙悟空打伤的模样。
听到虎君的询问。
白骨道君干枯的脸上，露出一抹笑容：
“虎君，我自然不可能被那猴妖所伤。”
虎君眉头轻皱：
“那道兄为何要佯装不敌？”
白骨道君本就没打算瞒着虎君。
它手指一个方向，微笑道：
“方才是“千面”

道友，给我传音。”
“让我二人先装作不敌退走。”
“它有更好的办法，解决那猴妖和蛟龙！”
白骨道君所指的方向，正是“姚家村”
听到白骨道君的话。
虎君眉头一皱：
“那头老狐狸？”
“它不是整日混在了人族村庄里，扮起了假道士吗？”
“平日里，我邀请它来洞中小聚，它都不来。”
“这次为何主动找上道兄你了？”
那狐妖，名为“千面”
，也有着两三千年的道行。
千面并非这附近的妖精。
而是白骨道君在外游历时认识。
数十年前，对方跟随白骨道君来到听云峰附近修行。
虎君与那千面狐妖，算不上太熟悉。
但看在白骨道君的面子上，虎君之前也邀请过对方几次。
但都被那只老狐狸以“不便露面”
给拒绝了。
content_en:
Listen to Yunfeng.
Inside the Tiger Cave.
Lord Tiger frowned and looked at Lord White Bone Taoist:
"Brother Taoist, I think that monkey demon is quite strong."
"But he won't defeat you in just a few rounds, right?"
Regarding the strength of White Bone Dao Lord.
Mr. Tiger knows very well.
When the opponent actually fights, his strength will never be inferior to his own!
Although the monkey demon is extremely talented.
But it is impossible to easily defeat the White Bone Dao Lord in the late Earth Immortal stage.
At this time, the White Bone Dao Lord was calm and relaxed.
There is no sign of being injured by Sun Wukong at all.
Hear Mr. Tiger's inquiry.
A smile appeared on the dry face of the White Bone Dao Lord:
"Tiger Lord, of course I can't be hurt by that monkey demon."
Mr. Tiger frowned slightly:
"Then why does Brother Dao pretend to be defeated?"
Lord White Bone Taoist had no intention of hiding this from Lord Tiger.
It pointed in a direction and smiled:
"Just now is "Thousand Faces"
Fellow Taoist, send me a message. "
"Let the two of us pretend to be defeated and retreat."
"It has a better way to deal with the monkey demon and the dragon!"
The direction that Lord White Bones pointed was exactly "Yaojia Village"
Hearing what Lord White Bone Taoist said.
Mr. Tiger frowned:
"That old fox?"
"Didn't it hang out in the human village all day long, pretending to be a fake Taoist priest?"
"On weekdays, I invite it to come to the cave for a small gathering, but it doesn't come."
"Why did you take the initiative to find you, Taoist brother, this time?"
That fox demon is called "Thousand Faces"
, also has two or three thousand years of Taoism.
Thousand Faces is not the goblin around here.
But Taojun Baigu met him when he was traveling abroad.
Decades ago, the other party followed Lord White Bone Taoist to practice near Tingyun Peak.
Tiger Lord and the thousand-faced fox demon are not very familiar.
But for the sake of Lord White Bone Taoist, Lord Tiger had invited him several times before.
But the old fox said it was "inconvenient to show up"
Rejected.
